newsitem.title: USA: Converse sees Q1 sales 50 pct above yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Converse sees Q1 sales 50 pct above yr ago.

text.p: Converse Inc on Monday said that based on its order momentum, it expects to report an increase of about 50 percent in sales for the first quarter compared with a year ago.

The company said customer orders continued their upward momentum during the current quarter after Converse's backlog rose to $183.3 million at December 28, 1996, from $131.9 million at the end of 1995.

Earlier, the company reported revenues for the fourth quarter were $69.6 million, compared with $76.8 million a year ago. The loss from operations was $5.4 million, which included restructuring costs of $1.0 million, versus a loss from operations of $35.2 million in the fourth quarter of the previous year, which included restructuring costs of $13.2 million. The net loss was $8.4 million, or $0.50 per share, compared to a net loss of $41.3 million, or $2.48 per share, for the fourth quarter of 1995.
